initial.title: [v0.92.1][OBS-A] Observatory experience design
initial.goal: Produce one reviewed Observatory experience-design contract.
initial.required_outcome: One reviewed Observatory design contract covering information, interaction, states, hierarchy, and accessibility.
authority_boundary: This issue owns design only; production implementation belongs to #512
Runtime fields must be sourced from existing Runtime contracts and evidence
operator_constraints: No tracked implementation work on main
initial.task_boundary: Exactly one Observatory experience-design contract and its validation plan.
deliverables: Empty degraded recovery and revoked-state matrix
acceptance_criteria: AC-1: Every view has a stable information contract
AC-2: Empty degraded recovery and revoked states are designed
AC-3: Keyboard and screen-reader flows are specified
AC-4: No invented Runtime field is introduced
AC-5: One-command pre-cutover canary passes with v2 authority and v3 local non-authority evidence
initial.plan_summary: Define the Observatory experience contract, enumerate state and accessibility behavior, verify Runtime field provenance, and retain review-ready evidence.

steps.action: Inventory the existing Observatory UI and Runtime projection fields that may be consumed.
Write the per-view information contract and state matrix.
Write keyboard and screen-reader flows for every designed state.
Run the focused contract, accessibility-plan, Runtime-field-census, v3 local canary, and review proof.

invariants: Design does not invent Runtime fields
Accessibility states are first-class design truth
risks: Existing Runtime projection docs may be incomplete
Design may accidentally depend on future #512 implementation
stop_conditions: A design requires unavailable Runtime authority
A mock or invented Runtime field is needed
V3 local output is treated as lifecycle authority

validation_lanes.proof_role: Verify every designed view has named fields, source, state behavior, and consumer responsibility.
validation_lanes.defer_reason: Issue-owned validator is an OBS-A implementation deliverable.

validation_lanes.proof_role: Verify empty degraded recovery and revoked states are explicitly covered.
validation_lanes.defer_reason: Issue-owned validator is an OBS-A implementation deliverable.

validation_lanes.proof_role: Verify keyboard and screen-reader flows are specified for each view and state.
validation_lanes.defer_reason: Issue-owned validator is an OBS-A implementation deliverable.

validation_lanes.proof_role: Verify each field is sourced from current Runtime artifacts or rejected.
validation_lanes.defer_reason: Issue-owned validator is an OBS-A implementation deliverable.

validation_lanes.proof_role: Run the single csdlc binary local preparation path as non-authoritative cutover evidence.

initial.failure_policy: Fail closed on invented Runtime fields, incomplete accessibility denominator, production implementation drift, or v3 authority overclaim.
review_prompts: Does every designed field cite real Runtime authority?
Are degraded and revoked states user-visible and testable?
Can #512 implement this without design invention?
initial.review_scope: OBS-A design contract, accessibility/state coverage, Runtime-field provenance, and pre-cutover canary evidence only.
